note: NECO English round 5 (R32 top-up): synonyms diligent, dwindled, alleviated, candid, impartial; antonyms bold, generous, humble, ancient, barren; idioms blessing in disguise, deaf ear, eleventh hour, make ends meet, white elephant, pull strings; collocations took effect, raised objection, accepted defeat, took off; in-context high spirits, figurehead, in the red; future perfect, hardly-when, quality-of agreement, However hard, Each of the two, stemmed from; orals /ae/, /o/ short, silent l in salmon, x as /gz/, rhyme for beard, diphthong of fire. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC English (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
